proposals.evidence: Previously reviewed comparative evidence: CDIAL 6328 dina lists Prakrit diṇa and Nepali, Assamese, Bengali, Maithili, Awadhi and Hindi din “day”. It explicitly warns that Punjabi/Western Pahari din is borrowed from Hindi or Sanskrit, as are potentially Gujarati/Marathi forms; those transmission-sensitive matches are held. Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: CDIAL 6328 marks several western din forms as Hindi/Sanskrit loans; establish the immediate local transmission before using a reflex edge.

proposals.evidence: Previously reviewed comparative evidence: CDIAL 11392.2 varṣa gives Prakrit varisa, Hindi baras, Old Marwari barasa, Gujarati varas, Bihari baris and northwestern varh-/varih- forms for “year”. Punjabi varas/baras is explicitly a Central loan; conservative ś/ṣ forms and local retroflex innovations are held rather than inferred automatically. Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: Year word requires a learned/contact or local sibilant check; CDIAL marks Punjabi baras as Central borrowing.

The selected aspirated retroflex forms identify this plant-name family, distinct from vātiṅgaṇa; source nasalization/gemination must be retained, and a deeper substrate origin is not settled. Updated disposition under the user’s explicit cross-Indo-Aryan policy: link this supported etymon despite unresolved inheritance versus intra-Indo-Aryan borrowing. The reflex edge records etymological family affiliation provisionally; it does not establish uninterrupted inheritance or an immediate donor. Prior hold: The bhaṇṭā eggplant family is clear, but these western forms need a regional transmission check against the primarily eastern CDIAL comparanda.
